title: The segment-averaged right-hand side is a Hoelder family of linear forms on L(R^n, R^l)
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, alpha > 0, H and d real numbers, g : R^n -> R^l, S and K subsets of R^n and e in R^n, such that x + (td)e lies in K for all x in S and t in [0,1], and ||g(x) - g(y)|| <= H ||x - y||^alpha for x, y in K. Then there is a map Phi from R^n to continuous linear forms on L := L(R^n, R^l) such that Phi(x)[P] = < integral_0^1 g(x + (td)e) dt , Pe > for all x in R^n and P in L, and |Phi(x)[P] - Phi(y)[P]| <= H ||e|| ||x - y||^alpha ||P|| for all x, y in S and P in L.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (α H d : ℝ) (g : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (S K : Set (Rn n)) (e : Rn n), 0 < α → (∀ x ∈ S, ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, x + (t * d) • e ∈ K) → (∀ x ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ K, ‖g x - g y‖ ≤ H * ‖x - y‖ ^ α) → ∃ Φ : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ, (∀ (x : Rn n) (P : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ), Φ x P = inner ℝ (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, g (x + (t * d) • e)) (P e)) ∧ ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, ∀ P : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, |Φ x P - Φ y P| ≤ H * ‖e‖ * ‖x - y‖ ^ α * ‖P‖
